name: Zoom Hero
tagline: A hero you can dive into: click a spot in one wide scene and the camera zooms into a tiny detail, then closer still.
youSay: /zoom-hero A natural-wine estate: from the hill down to the wild yeast on a grape
whatYouGet: One wide scene with spots to click: the camera dives into a tiny detail until it fills the screen, then dives again, and zooms back out in one go
A tree of matched pictures, each close-up made from a crop of the level above and measured to sit exactly over it, so detail comes into focus with no jump
A viewfinder interface: size labels on the spots, brackets that grow with each dive, live readouts of field width and zoom, a scale from kilometres to nanometres, breadcrumbs, pinned notes
Words, type and colours chosen for your subject, a layout for phones, a headless check and a dive video, as a static site you can host anywhere
goodFit: Brands whose reason to buy is too small to see: craft, ingredients, materials, wildlife, science
Stories that go deep in a few steps, and playful pages such as a seek-and-find game
notFor: Pages that must be very light: each level is a large picture, drawn in WebGL
Exact product detail: generated close-ups are imagined, so don't use them to prove a real specification
youBring: The business or subject, and what is hidden in it
Optional: your own photo for the first level, the brand's name, colours and tone
needs: Chrome or Edge, for the check and the video

generates.estimate: 20 a picture: about 320 for 8 levels with two takes each

network.purpose: the tools' sharp and playwright-core packages, installed once
